H.name: Hydrogen
H.fact: The lightest and most common element in the universe. Stars like our Sun are mostly hydrogen.

C.name: Carbon
C.fact: Carbon is found in every living thing. Diamond and pencil graphite are both pure carbon!

N.name: Nitrogen
N.fact: About 78% of the air you breathe is nitrogen gas, N₂.

O.name: Oxygen
O.fact: A common element in Earth's atmosphere and in water. Most living things need it to release energy from food.

Na.name: Sodium
Na.fact: A soft, silvery metal. Pure sodium is so reactive that it is stored in oil, yet it is part of harmless table salt.

Cl.name: Chlorine
Cl.fact: Chlorine is used to keep swimming pools clean. Combined with sodium, it forms table salt.

Ca.name: Calcium
Ca.fact: Calcium helps build strong bones and teeth. It is also found in limestone, chalk and seashells.

Fe.name: Iron
Fe.fact: Iron is the main ingredient of steel. Earth's core is mostly iron and nickel.
